person.name: Jon Maestas
person.summary: Jon Maestas is a software builder in Wright City, Missouri, and the founder of SmopLab LLC. He builds Player 1, an AI sports coach app for iPhone and Android, Player 1: Diamond Setup, an AR field layout app for baseball and softball, and free web tools and guides for coaches and athletes. His kids created and operate Reindeer Food Co., a Christmas Eve business featured on The Next New Thing.
bio: I live in Wright City, Missouri with my wife, Kristin, and our three daughters. They play softball, basketball, soccer and gymnastics, and I still coach them, even in the sports I don't fully know.
In high school I played baseball, basketball and football. I earned a baseball scholarship to Culver-Stockton College in Canton, Missouri, which is where I met Kristin.
I build software through my company, SmopLab LLC. Player 1 started because I wanted something in my pocket that looks at my kids' actual reps, not a random YouTube tip, between practices and lessons.
I write about building in public, AI agents and Athletic Intelligence on the blog.

apps.name: Player 1: Athletic Intelligence
apps.tagline: The free AI sports coach on your phone.
apps.summary: Record a rep or a whole practice. Player 1 finds each rep, tells you what to keep and what to fix next, and you can text your coach film or questions any time. Phone camera only: no bat sensor, launch monitor or wearable.
details: 13 sports on one account: baseball, softball, golf, football, basketball, soccer, tennis, volleyball, pickleball, disc golf, gymnastics, hockey, and track & field.
Training Sessions: film a full practice and the AI splits it into reps you can compare side by side.
Coach Chat: text your coach film or mechanics questions, 24/7.
Coach Styles from supportive to demanding, and X-Factor Focus on power, speed, accuracy, balance, timing and more.
Built for kids, parents and coaches, and it works for adult golf swings and rec players too.
apps.pricing: Free to start, no credit card: 5 reps without an account, 7 free reps every week with a free email sign-in. Pro is $9.99/month or $76/year for unlimited reps.

apps.name: Player 1: Diamond Setup
apps.tagline: Lay out a baseball or softball field with your iPhone.
apps.summary: Point the phone at the ground and Diamond Setup draws home plate, the pitching rubber and the bases in AR at your league's distances. Set up a bullpen or a whole diamond without a tape measure, then put the real bases on the outlines.
details: Bullpen layout for pitching practice, plus Full Field and Base by Base (beta).
Presets from 46′ Little League to 60′ 6″ high school and adult baseball, 35′ to 43′ fastpitch, slowpitch, or your own distances.
Mound height, feet or meters, and it works with no cell signal.
No account, no ads, no tracking. The camera view is never recorded or uploaded.
Any iPhone with iOS 18 or later. On LiDAR models the lines follow slopes in the ground.
apps.pricing: $4.99 one-time on the App Store (launch promo price). No subscription.
